title: WHO: in 2024, 35 million children under 5 and 170 million children and adolescents were living with excess weight of the kinds the sheet names
summary: The obesity fact sheet says 35 million children under 5 were overweight, and 400 million people aged 5 to 19 were overweight, including 170 million with obesity.
body: WHO's obesity fact sheet says that in 2024, 35 million children under the age of 5 were overweight. It says 400 million children and adolescents aged 5 to 19 were overweight, including 170 million living with obesity. The sheet uses "overweight" for the larger counts and "obesity" for the 170 million. This card keeps those words apart.
